device.thermal_observation: Android reported status 0; thermal HAL reported unavailable. Battery temperature is not GPU temperature.

protocol.scene: Actual 194-mesh menu, held 640x480 viewport, fixed noon and random seed, Original options, max_fps=60, four frames then GPU readback.
protocol.figure_specialization: Gfx._compact_figures=false on both engines to isolate the engine change in an identical frozen pack.
protocol.cold_definition: Only the private QA Godot shader cache was removed. CPU asset caches remained warm; driver-managed caches were not controlled.
protocol.warm_definition: Immediate new-process launch reusing the preceding same-menu shader cache.
protocol.instrumentation: Same compile/cache timers on both audit engines. Native timings include GL compile/link and uniform discovery, exclude the following audit log write. Menu wall time includes those log writes.
protocol.uninstrumented_control: One additional cold pair with original and candidate native libraries, with no profiling logs, confirms the direction and approximate size of the wall-time difference.
protocol.timing_boundary: Menu setup through GPU readback excludes earlier engine startup and intro movies; it is not total app launch latency or gameplay FPS.
protocol.warm_cache_policy: Old cached default programs are retained; existing installations gain the cold benefit when a new shader version or empty cache requires compilation.

cache_validation.partial_cache_result: A separate colour-only seed process saved empty maps for modes 1, 2 and 3. Next-process logs show a one-program cache load, then on-demand instanced colour (1), instanced depth (3) and ordinary depth (2), with all captures identical to baseline.

campaign_lifecycle.scope: Real simulation service: new campaign, authored dialogue, paused save/load, service suspension/resumption and intentional-pause preservation, worker shutdown. Suspension is driven through the service API; this run is not an Android Home/activity recreation test.

known_warnings: Both baseline and candidate QA runs emit the existing nonfatal Scudo allocation-region warning; this patch does not claim to fix it.

cleanup.note: Original data archives were read from the existing performance package and copied into the isolated QA package. All settings, caches, saves and captures were written only to the QA package.

limitations: One available Android GPU/driver; Redmagic Adreno 840 remains untested.
No native fault stack connects the original crash to shader compilation.
First use of a missing specialization still compiles synchronously, as before.
No sustained gameplay, memory or thermal benchmark was performed.
Private debuggable QA container and debug signature are not distributable release artifacts.
